labels.name: Metaphysis
labels.function: Usual site of bloodstream seeding in children (femur, tibia)

labels.name: Vascular loops
labels.function: Sluggish blood flow here lets circulating bacteria settle

labels.name: Cortex
labels.function: Its destruction or loss is seen on x-ray and MRI

labels.name: Bone marrow
labels.function: Edema here is an MRI sign before x-ray changes appear

labels.name: Joint space
labels.function: Contiguous spread here causes septic arthritis

labels.name: Periosteal reaction
labels.function: Plain-film sign that appears once bone destruction starts

labels.name: Abscess
labels.function: Pus collection that impinges on vessels supplying bone

labels.name: Sequestrum
labels.function: Necrotic fragment poorly penetrated by antibiotics

labels.name: Endocarditis
labels.function: Heart-valve source of bacteremia that can seed distant bone

labels.name: Hematogenous spread
labels.function: Most common route in infants and children

labels.name: Vertebral body
labels.function: Most common adult site of blood-borne bone infection

labels.name: Paraspinal abscess
labels.function: Pus collection seen on MRI in Pott disease

labels.name: Diabetic foot ulcer
labels.function: Painless portal of entry over a bony prominence

labels.name: Contiguous spread
labels.function: Route from adjacent soft-tissue infection into bone

labels.name: Prosthetic joint
labels.function: Hardware that raises adjacent infection risk (S. epidermidis)

labels.name: Direct inoculation
labels.function: Organisms introduced at a surgical or deep wound site
